subject.title: Architecture: reduce import coupling in pi-embedded-runner/attempt.ts (50+ imports) and discord monitor (30 imports)

question: Should this issue remain the canonical combined tracker for embedded-runner import coupling plus Discord monitor boundary cleanup, or should maintainers split the remaining work between the RuntimePlan RFC and a separate Discord monitor issue?
rationale: The remaining work spans two hot ownership boundaries, and the open RuntimePlan RFC covers only the embedded-runner half, so automation should not choose the permanent tracker split or implementation order.

options.title: Keep Combined Tracker
options.body: Use this issue as the canonical staged refactor covering both embedded-runner and Discord monitor coupling, with maintainers sequencing smaller PRs.

options.title: Split Remaining Scope
options.body: Move embedded-runner cleanup under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/72072 and create or identify a separate Discord monitor boundary issue before closing this combined tracker.

options.title: Defer Until RuntimePlan Settles
options.body: Leave this issue open but blocked on RuntimePlan cleanup direction, then reassess whether the Discord monitor still needs its own follow-up.

recommendation.title: Keep Combined Tracker
recommendation.body: Use this issue as the canonical staged refactor covering both embedded-runner and Discord monitor coupling, with maintainers sequencing smaller PRs.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest combined signal across the live issue review and recent current-main history for both affected surfaces.
